faq.question: What makes ReGen Performance different?
faq.answer: At ReGen Performance, we don't just train you. You learn how to move, lift, and perform better. We combine strength training, movement optimization, and injury prevention. Every session is designed to make you stronger, more resilient, and pain-free, so you achieve long-term results without sacrificing your body.

faq.question: How do I get started?
faq.answer: Send us a WhatsApp message at 9187 5632 to book a free 30-minute discovery call. During the call, we discuss your goals, assess your movement needs, and map out a personalized plan to help you succeed.

faq.question: What happens in my first session?
faq.answer:
Your first session focuses on understanding your body. You can expect:

- A comprehensive movement assessment to identify strengths and imbalances
- A goal-setting discussion to align training with your needs
- Guided exercises to help you feel and move better right away
- A clear game plan so you know what to do next

You will leave ready for the next step.

faq.question: Do you work with beginners?
faq.answer: Yes, we do. Whether you are just starting out or have trained for years, we adapt our programs to where you are now. Our goal is to build your strength and movement quality without extreme workouts. Expect smart, effective training that makes you feel good in your body.

faq.question: How do you help with injuries?
faq.answer:
Injury support is our specialty. We build strength and resilience so your body can handle daily life and training stress. Our approach prioritizes:

- Proper load management to avoid overuse and strain
- Optimal joint positioning for pain-free movement
- Exercises tailored to you, so you grow stronger without aggravating injuries

Train smarter and move better for life.

faq.question: Can you help me get a six-pack?
faq.answer:
Yes, we can help with abs. A six-pack is a byproduct of smart training, not endless crunches. We help you:

- Lose fat and build muscle sustainably
- Train for looks and function
- Move better, feel stronger, and enjoy training

We're not a hardcore bootcamp. We focus on lifting well so you build a body that moves as well as it looks.
